snippet.title: Townsfolk Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Build. Explore. Survive. Your journey into the unknown begins!

In TownFolk: A New Journey, you’ll lead a band of settlers as they carve out a home in an uncharted land full of mystery, danger, and opportunity. But survival won’t be easy—manage scarce resources, expand wisely, and face the ever-growing demands of the King.

Key Features:
🛠 Manage Your Settlement – Balance Food, Gold, Faith, Production, and People to keep your town thriving.
🌍 Explore the Unknown – Reveal hidden tiles, uncover secrets, and face unexpected challenges.
⚖️ Make Tough Choices – Disasters, wild animals, and shifting circumstances will test your leadership.
👑 Tribute or Trouble? – The King expects his due—fail to pay, and your colony’s future may be at risk.

Will your settlement stand the test of time, or crumble under the weight of the wild and the crown?
